_format: Labelled intended differences between old Vantage and 2Vantage screens (plan.md §12.7; Q.5 'Judging').
Files have their own register: tools/parity/intended.yaml. Empty to start; the Look report lists every unlabelled difference.
One entry per difference the plan causes on purpose; anything else that differs fails the lane.
screen:     a key of look/screens.mjs, e.g. 'gd1.advisor'
width:      1280 | 1440 | 1920, or null for every width
selector:   for 'style', the key selector; otherwise null
item:       the plan item that causes it (an X.3 row ID or an OQ), e.g. 'A21'
why:        one sentence, in the plan's words
new_sha256: the SHA-256 of 2Vantage's capture when Daniel signed it; a changed image is judged again
signed_by, signed_on: Daniel and the date (YYYY-MM-DD), null until signed

Slice 15's station (E1–E32): 2Vantage's GD1 carries two synthetic files (an Aetna renewal PDF and a Cigna quote workbook, golden/files.py) that the old parity load does not upload, so 2V shows the file tabs with bucket tags, 📚 All proposals, ✎ File / Remove / Expand, the file bar and the viewer where the old app says "No documents yet"; "＋ Add files" and the File-as list stand in for the ✦ Work with Claude button and drawer until slice 20 (E4); the subtitle names only what is built. With files that have values, the Scanned data panel opens as the List beside the file (E35, E56, D121, D122: the old app's default view, kept per browser, whose side-by-side layout is the List's only), with the quality headline (E34), ☰ List / ▦ Grid, ○ Review and ✎ Edit (E35, E65, E66), the Find bar (E60), the bucket chips, the bulk bar with Check this file (E58, E59), the keys and ↶ Undo (D124, E54); where the old GD1 has no files it shows the plan grid of every plan, stacked under the empty viewer, with no plan filter and no file strip (both need a file). On ▦ Grid 2V draws the old station grid (E36–E41) for the file's plans only, with the file strip over it (E48), the plan filter (E50) and the pick bar (E52). The Change history lists the deal's Activity rows grouped by person (E73), so GD1's seeding shows as one long group; the old card listed versions (dropped, E72).

The Scanned data panel's List, Change history and station classes (bnf-frl-*, gs-legend, gs-done, hst-*; bb-doc-tab*, bnf-doc-*, bnf-file-bar*, bb-pdf-*, bnf-sheet-*) are slices 15–17's (E1–E59, E73, E74), against an old GD1 with no files whose panel is the plan grid (bnf-compare-table, gs-toolbar, gs-pick, sf-*); 2V draws those classes on ▦ Grid (slice 23, E36–E41, E50–E52, E60–E64), so the default List view counts far fewer.

Values printed in GD1's synthetic files (slice 15, golden/files.py) carry the old ↗ pin on hover (bnf-has-src, bnf-src-pin), which opens the value in Documents; the old parity load has no files, so its cells have none.
